_note: Voice casting for the local Audio Studio (Qwen3-TTS). `instruct` describes the voice for qwen-design; `sample` is what each candidate says (it becomes the clone reference, so it must be 5-10 s); `pick` is the chosen candidate (1-3), default 1 until the owner chooses by ear on sounds.html (KB rules 9, 20).

AKSE.name: Corin Aske, Basin Concord liaison
AKSE.instruct: A man in his fifties, a civil-service officer. Dry, precise, quietly tired; mid-low pitch, clipped consonants, neutral northern European English accent, measured pace with small pauses. Speaks like a radio briefing in a cold command tent. No warmth, no theatre.
AKSE.sample: Captain. The Directorate pushed a recon group into the yard before dawn. We need it open by noon.

MARLOW.name: Capt. Ines Marlow
MARLOW.instruct: A woman in her late thirties, a veteran mercenary walker pilot and company captain. Low, slightly husky voice, calm and controlled authority, a little weary, never shouting unless hit. Plain, grounded delivery over a cockpit radio.
MARLOW.sample: Understood. Varga takes the left track. The rest of you come up the middle with me.

OKONJO.name: Dace Okonjo
OKONJO.instruct: A big man in his late forties, heavy-walker pilot. Very deep, resonant, unhurried voice with a West African lilt; calm under fire, economical with words, a faint smile in the tone.
OKONJO.sample: Okonjo here. Shield is up, mortar is loaded. Tell me where you want it.

VARGA.name: Pell Varga
VARGA.instruct: A young man in his early twenties, scout pilot. Light, quick, wry voice with nervous energy; fast pace, cocky but likeable, slight Central European accent.
VARGA.sample: Varga, ready. Sensor mast is up and I can see half the yard. They have no idea.

HALDANE.name: Ruth 'Hook' Haldane
HALDANE.instruct: A woman in her fifties, mechanic and support pilot. Gravelly, smoky low voice, dry deadpan humour, Scottish accent, sounds like she has fixed every machine in the yard twice.
HALDANE.sample: Haldane. Make it quick, I have a welding torch in one hand and your leg actuator in the other.

HALLEN.name: Maj. Teodric Hallen, Northern Directorate
HALLEN.instruct: A man in his forties, an enemy officer. Cold, clipped, contemptuous; hard consonants, a slight Germanic accent, controlled and quiet menace over a crackling radio.
HALLEN.sample: Contract dogs. Hold the silos and let them come to us. Nobody fires until I say.
